pwa.update.message: A new version of this site is ready.
push.toggle.label: Notifications in this browser
push.toggle.description: Get a notification on this device when a channel you follow goes live, even when this site is closed.
push.vendorNote: Your browser's maker relays these notifications to this device. They are encrypted on the way and carry only the channel and the stream title.
push.unsupported: This browser cannot show notifications from this site. Try another browser, or install the site as an app first.
push.deniedHelp: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings (the icon beside the address), then reload this page.
push.toast.on: Notifications are on in this browser.
push.toast.off: Notifications are off in this browser.
push.error.on: Could not turn notifications on. Try again.
push.error.off: Could not turn notifications off. Try again.
